bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Smooth Fox Terrier owners tracking 12-15 years lifespans still lose the mid-series booster more often than the first shot, and the unprotected gap after week 8 is where parvovirus risk concentrates for this puppy.
Use the 4-row Smooth Fox Terrier schedule as your only planning spine: 8 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP); 12 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP booster); 16 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP booster); 16 weeks (Rabies).

Temperament note for Smooth Fox Terrier handling: Classic earthdog; deafness can appear.. Schedule quieter appointment slots if that profile makes clinic visits harder, but do not skip the Smooth Fox Terrier dose.
Lifestyle add-ons stay off this Smooth Fox Terrier core list until your veterinarian maps exposure, so keep core dates sacred either way.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Smooth Fox Terrier boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Smooth Fox Terrier row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Smooth Fox Terrier item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Smooth Fox Terrier kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Smooth Fox Terrier due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Smooth Fox Terrier core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Smooth Fox Terrier misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Smooth Fox Terrier health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Smooth Fox Terrier adult health guide for breed predispositions such as deafness risk, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
